# CBOE fixture provenance

`_SPX_sample.json` is **schema-accurate but NOT a live capture**. The spec
asks for one real CBOE response trimmed to ~30 options; the development
environment's network egress allowlist blocks `cdn.cboe.com` (403 "Host not
in allowlist"), so this file was generated by `_generate_sample.py` instead:
the exact payload shape of
`https://cdn.cboe.com/api/global/delayed_quotes/options/_SPX.json`
(top-level `data.current_price`, `data.options[]` rows with `option`, `bid`,
`ask`, `iv`, `delta`, `gamma`, `theta`, `vega`, `volume`, `open_interest`,
`last_trade_price`, …) with Black-Scholes-consistent quotes around spot
6010.25, frozen at 2026-06-10T14:45Z, plus deliberately broken rows that
exercise every data-quality rule.

**TODO (first run outside the sandbox):** replace this file with a real
capture —

```sh
curl -H "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" \
  https://cdn.cboe.com/api/global/delayed_quotes/options/_SPX.json \
  | python -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); d["data"]["options"]=d["data"]["options"][:30]; json.dump(d, sys.stdout, indent=1)' \
  > _SPX_sample.json
```

then update the frozen `NOW`/spot constants in `tests/test_cboe.py` to match
the captured payload.
